notes.title: Evolution Update
notes.content:
[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Enemies Evolve:[/b] After beating your first run, you unlock the "Enemies Evolve" feature which causes one enemy type from each arena to evolve into a unique form with different behaviour.
[*][b]Player Character Reworks:[/b] In addition to starting with specific emblems and different stats, the Alchemist and the Oracle now have unique modifiers. ([i]read more below[/i])
[*][b]Dynamic Tooltips:[/b] Spells, runes, and emblems now display damage numbers and other values and dynamically update based on the player's stats.
[*][b]New Rune - Burst (Reactive):[/b] Whenever you take damage, this spell is cast for free targeting the damage source.
[*][b]New Rune - Fireball (Infuse):[/b] This spell now deals (230% power) fire damage but costs 10 mana.
[*][b]New Rune - Ignite (Rev):[/b] Every 3 casts empowers you, causing the next damage spell you cast to deal 30% bonus damage.
[*][b]New Rune - Lash (Expose):[/b] Enemies damaged by this spell take 25% more fire and arcane damage for 5 seconds.
[*][b]New Rune - Power Fist (Pummel):[/b] This spell can no longer uppercut but its base cast speed is increased by 50%.
[*][b]New Rune - Ravage (Hellmouth):[/b] The spectral mouth now remains in place and instead releases pulses of fire that deal 200% fire damage per second to enemies within 4.5 tiles.
[*][b]New Emblem - Dream Eater:[/b] You have 1 bonus life regeneration (up to 10) for each incapacitated enemy within 4 tiles.
[*][b]New Emblem - Mana Shield:[/b] Up to 50% of incoming damage is blocked, consuming (200% damage blocked) mana. ([i]previous Mana Shield emblem renamed[/i])
[*][b]New Emblem - Siren's Song:[/b] Feared enemies are charmed instead, causing them to walk towards you and take 20% more damage for the duration.
[*][b]Reworked Spell - Starfall:[/b] Bombards target position with 3 waves of stars, each dealing (200% power) arcane damage to enemies within 3 tiles.
[*][b]Reworked Rune - Dragon's Breath (Napalm, [i]previously Brood[/i]):[/b] This spell instead launches balls of sticky napalm that ignite the ground for 5 seconds, dealing (200% power) fire damage per second.
[*][b]Reworked Rune - Starfall (Orbit, [i]previously Barrage[/i]):[/b] You gain a marker that orbits you. This spell now deals (300% power) arcane damage but always targets the marker's position.
[/list]

[h3]Player[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]The Alchemist:[/b] Now occasionally chooses alchemy ingredients that permanently enhance potions, no longer starts with the Bookworm emblem, base stats reduced,
[*][b]The Oracle:[/b] Ghosts now appear during combat and attack the player with different weapons, instead chooses spells from altars instead of chests, no longer chooses any defensive/expert spell, no longer has reduced stats.
[/list]

[h3]Spells[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Ignite:[/b] Range reduced from 8 tiles to 7.
[*][b]Meteor Form:[/b] Base cooldown increased from 12 seconds to 15, damage increased from 300% of power to 400%.
[*][b]Ravage:[/b] Damage per second increased from 340% of power to 360%.
[*][b]Static Discharge:[/b] Damage increased from 700% of power to 800%.
[*][b]Solar Beam:[/b] Damage ticks per second increased from 5 to 8, damage per second increased from 210%-450% of power to 200%-480%.
[/list]

[h3]Runes[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Drain Soul (Empower):[/b] Now grants 1.5% bonus power per stack (up to 30%), duration reduced from 30 seconds to 20.
[*][b]Meteor Form (Hypervelocity):[/b] Base cooldown increased from 8 seconds to 10.
[*][b]Starfall (Consecration):[/b] Duration increased from 4.5 seconds to 5.
[/list]

[h3]Emblems[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Alchemy:[/b] Potion spawn rate reduced from 350% to 200%, renamed to [b]Alchemist's Curse[/b].
[*][b]Blessing of Elusivity:[/b] Bonus ranged resistance increased from 30 to 60.
[*][b]Blessing of Toughness:[/b] Bonus melee resistance increased from 30 to 60.
[*][b]Blessing of Vitality:[/b] Bonus maximum life increased from 30 to 50.
[*][b]Bone Armor:[/b] Bonus resistances per shard reduced from 5 to 3, cap increased from 70 to 80, loss per damage instance reduced from 2 to 1.
[*][b]Boulder Stance:[/b] Power bonus increased from 20% to 25%, move speed penalty reduced from 50% to 35%.
[*][b]Enlightened:[/b] Bonus power increased from 20% to 25%, bonus resistances increased from 40 to 50.
[*][b]Fire Insight:[/b] Bonus power increased from 10% to 15%.
[*][b]Mana Shield:[/b] Renamed to [b]Hermit's Incantation[/b].
[*][b]Markman's Brew:[/b] [b]Removed[/b]. ([i]now an Alchemist potion ingredient - see above[/i])
[*][b]Photosynthesis:[/b] Now reduces regeneration by 70% while moving instead of preventing it entirely.
[*][b]Potion Guzzler:[/b] [b]Removed[/b]. ([i]now an Alchemist potion ingredient - see above[/i])
[*][b]Reckless Strike:[/b] Cast no longer deal self damage and instead increases all damage taken by 20% for 2 seconds.
[*][b]Time Leak:[/b] Catching a clock now only reduces the cooldown timer of the spell that created it, cooldown timer reduction increased from 2.5 seconds to 4 seconds, clock catch radius increased from 2 tiles to 2.5.
[*][b]Ward:[/b] Damage reduction increased form 25% to 30%.
[/list]

[h3]Enemies[/h3]
[list]
[*]Reduced attack speeds of most enemies.
[*]Reduced move speeds of most enemies slightly.
[*]Boss enrage attack and move speeds reduced slightly.
[*][b]Boss - Conservator:[/b] Life increased significantly.
[*][b]Boss - Scourge:[/b] Lightning dance lightning fist interval increased and duration reduced.
[*][b]Boss - Warden:[/b] Reduced damage of all attacks, reduced life.
[*][b]Clockwork Golem:[/b] Lasers now deal ranged damage.
[/list]

[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*]Potions heal less but drop more often.
[*]True damage icon updated.
[*][b]Tome - Maximum Life:[/b] Bonus increased from 10 to 20, appear slightly less often.
[*][b]Tome - Melee Resistance:[/b] Bonus increased from 10 to 20, appear slightly less often.
[*][b]Tome - Ranged Resistance:[/b] Bonus increased from 10 to 20, appear slightly less often.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug where using the Ravage (Spew) spell/rune combination in a specific situation would crash the game.
[*]Fixed bug where player HUD tooltips/descriptions were hidden while a portal was open.
[*]Fixed bug where the melee resistance stat tooltip was displaying the incorrect melee damage reduction percentage.
[*]Fixed a visual bug where Chain Lightning spell could pass through walls.
[/list]

notes.title: Scourge Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049139/feaf233b906988b10ec85bba5937bc7668917b4d.png[/img]

[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]New Emblem - Bone Armor:[/b] Enemies sometimes drop bone shards on death. Collecting a bone shard grants you 5 bonus resistances (up to 70). Whenever you take damage from enemies, you lose 2 bonus resistances.
[*][b]New Emblem - Death Mark:[/b] A random non-boss enemy is marked every 8 seconds. Dashing through a marked enemy destroys it and causes enemies within 5 tiles to flee in fear for 3 seconds.
[*][b]New Emblem - Paragon Hourglass:[/b] Whenever you cast a cooldown spell, there is a (crit. strike chance)% chance to instantly reset its cooldown timer. The cooldown timers of defensive spells are instead reduced by 75%.
[*][b]Reworked Spell - Drain Soul:[/b] Absorb the life force of enemies within 5 tiles, knocking them back and healing you for (1.5% max. life) life per enemy (up to 50% of your maximum life).
[*][b]Reworked Spell - Grasping Vines:[/b] Summon a wave of vines that move towards target direction, rooting enemies in place and slowing their attack speeds by 40% for 5 seconds. ([b]see new runes below[/b])
[*][b]New Rune - Grasping Vines (Bloom):[/b] Vines enchant the ground for 7 seconds as they move. You have 5 bonus life regeneration while on enchanted ground.
[*][b]New Rune - Grasping Vines (Sprawl):[/b] This spell instead roots all enemies but its base cooldown is increased to 16 seconds.
[*][b]Reworked Emblem - Chronoblade ([i]previously Kill Time[/i]):[/b] Whenever you deal critical spell damage, all cooldown timers are reduced by 0.5 seconds. This effect can only occur once per spell cast.
[*][b]Reworked Emblem - Elemental Dominance ([i]previously Elemental Devotion[/i]):[/b] The element that is most prevalent among your equipped spells is empowered, increasing damage you deal of that element by 20%.
[*][b]Reworked Emblem - Fairy Ring:[/b] Every 6 seconds, enemies within 5 tiles are rooted for 2.5 seconds.
[*][b]Reworked Emblem - Flesh Weaving ([i]previously Reaper[/i]):[/b] Every 5 enemies you kill during combat grants you 1 bonus maximum life (up to 100) until end of combat.
[*][b]Reworked Emblem - Kinetic Impact ([i]previously Dynamo[/i]):[/b] Moving grants you charge, becoming fully charged after 12 tiles. Casting a damage spell expends all charge to grant it up to 50% bonus damage.
[*][b]Reworked Emblem - Masochism ([i]previously Dark Thirst[/i]):[/b] Whenever you take damage, you restore (100% unmitigated damage) mana.
[*][b]Reworked Emblem - Withdraw:[/b] After casting a defensive spell, create a small zone at your position for 5 seconds. While in the zone, all damage you take is reduced by 75%.
[*][b]Reworked Boss - The Scourge ([i]previously The Matriarch[/i]):[/b] The corpse of an ancient mage held together by magic and metal, the Scourge summons lightning fists and evil spirits to attack the player.
[*][b]Reworked Enemy - Imp ([i]previously Skeleton Archer[/i]):[/b] Follows the player, occasionally firing flaming projectiles.
[*][b]Reworked Enemy - Sentry ([i]previously Clockwork Cannon[/i]):[/b] Large automaton that occasionally fires a barrage of small missiles at the player.
[/list]

[h3]Player[/h3]
[list]
[*]Evading damage from most area of effect attacks now prevents player knock back.
[/list]

[h3]Spells[/h3]
[list]
[*]Cooldown for most spells (especially defensive spells) increased.
[*]Adjusted mana costs for various spells.
[*][b]Burst:[/b] Adjusted gamepad targeting such that closer targets are given higher priority.
[*][b]Buzzsaw:[/b] Now has a 6 second cooldown, damage increased from 450% of power to 600%.
[*][b]Electric Field:[/b] Damage reduced from 60% of power per second to 25%, slow increased from 25% to 60%.
[*][b]Ignite:[/b] Damage increased from 110% of power to 125%, range increased from 6 tiles to 8, cast speed reduced.
[*][b]Lash:[/b] Damage increased from 65% of power to 80%, cast speed reduced, sound effect volume and pitch reduced.
[*][b]Meteor Form:[/b] No longer grants bonus move speed, stun duration increased from 2 seconds to 2.5, flight time increased, now grants a brief period of 100% evasion upon landing, no longer triggers spike traps while airborne.
[/list]

[h3]Runes[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Buzzsaw (Rebound):[/b] Damage increased from 350% of power to 450%.
[*][b]Buzzsaw (Sol):[/b] Damage increased from 300% of power to 400%.
[*][b]Chain Lightning (Amplify):[/b] Damage increased from 85% of power to 100%, damage bonus per cast reduced from 30% to 25%, stack limit increased from 4 to 5.
[*][b]Ignite (Jumpstart):[/b] Damage increased from 220% of power to 300%, self-damage type changed from true to melee or ranged (whichever resistance is higher).
[*][b]Meteor Form (Hypervelocity):[/b] Base cooldown increased from 5 seconds to 8.
[*][b]Meteor Form (Slam):[/b] Instead deals (6x bonus max. life) bonus damage.
[*][b]Whirling Death (Pirouette):[/b] Dash casts now deal 30% less damage.
[/list]

[h3]Emblems[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Aftershock:[/b] Instead deals (15% enemy max. life) lightning damage per second to enemies that are stunned, feared, or rooted (rooted enemies take 50% less damage). Deals 75% less damage to bosses.
[*][b]Arcane Invocation:[/b] Bonus resistances per stack increased from 4 to 8.
[*][b]Backstab:[/b] Mark duration increased from 1.5 seconds to 4.
[*][b]Blessing of Accuracy:[/b] Bonus critical hit chance increased from 8.5% to 10%.
[*][b]Blessing of Dexterity:[/b] Bonus attack speed increased from 10% to 15%.
[*][b]Blessing of Haste:[/b] Bonus move speed increased from 1.5 to 2.5.
[*][b]Blessing of Elusivity:[/b] Bonus melee resistance increased from 12 to 30.
[*][b]Blessing of Rejuvenation:[/b] Bonus life regeneration increased from 2 to 2.5.
[*][b]Blessing of Strength:[/b] Bonus power increased from 10 to 15.
[*][b]Blessing of Toughness:[/b] Bonus melee resistance increased from 12 to 30.
[*][b]Blessing of Vitality:[/b] Bonus maximum life increased from 30 to 45.
[*][b]Boulder Stance:[/b] Bonus resistances increased from 30 to 60.
[*][b]Brawler:[/b] Bonus damage factor reduced from 30% of resistances to 20%.
[*][b]Emergency Supply:[/b] Lesser healing potion healing increased from 50% of normal potions to 75%, effect now triggers on spell cast end instead of on spell cast.
[*][b]Enlightened:[/b] Bonus resistances increased from 20 to 40.
[*][b]Excessive Force:[/b] Bonus critical hit damage increased from 30% to 50%.
[*][b]Grit:[/b] Bonus resistances per stack increased from 4 to 10.
[*][b]Mana Shield:[/b] Bonus resistances per stack increased from 2 to 5.
[*][b]Reckless Strikes:[/b] Self-damage type changed from true to melee or ranged (whichever resistance is higher), damage bonus increased from 20% to 25%.
[*][b]Reflect:[/b] Damage increased from 100% of unmitigated damage taken to 150%.
[*][b]Sumo:[/b] Instead deals (2x bonus max. life) damage, refresh time reduced from 3.5 seconds to 1, knockback greatly reduced.
[/list]

[h3]Enemies[/h3]
[list]
[*]Enemy projectiles are now standardized into types (basic and flaming) so they deal consistent damage regardless of enemy type.
[*]Projectiles fired by elite enemies are rendered in black and red to show that they deal significantly more damage.
[*]Danger zones of missiles/attacks from elite enemies have special indicators along their radius to show that they deal more damage.
[*]Adjusted base life, power, and scaling for all enemies. This was primarily done to have all enemies be closer in threat across all arenas for invasion portals (challenge level 3).
[*]Many boss attacks now scale at lower life.
[*][b]Boss - The Conservator:[/b] Gains new attacks: [b]lay eggs[/b] and [b]launch drones[/b], trailblaze attack duration and cooldown greatly reduced.
[*][b]Boss - The Warden:[/b] Gains a new attack: [b]flail spin[/b], flail slam attack now launches rock missiles in all directions.
[*][b]Clockwork Golem:[/b] Laser now deals true damage and turns in a fixed direction.
[*][b]Giant Frog:[/b] Attacks instead launch an explosive missile at the player's predicted position, visuals updated.
[*][b]Ogre:[/b] Attacks no longer launch missiles but instead cause a line of melee spikes to erupt from the ground.
[*][b]Screecher:[/b] Attacks instead fire a wave of projectiles at the player.
[*][b]Vulture:[/b] Reduced move speed and turn rate.
[/list]

[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*]Damage for all hazards reduced.
[*]Healing potions healing amount reduced, but potions drop more frequently and consistently.
[*]Default controller button for dash changed from "left stick button" to "A".
[*]Default controller button for interact changed from "A" to "X".
[*][b]Tome - Attack Speed:[/b] Bonus increased from 4% to 5%.
[*][b]Tome - Maximum Life:[/b] Bonus increased from 10 to 15.
[*][b]Tome - Melee Resistance:[/b] Bonus increased from 5 to 12.
[*][b]Tome - Move Speed:[/b] Bonus increased from 0.5 to 0.7.
[*][b]Tome - Ranged Resistance:[/b] Bonus increased from 5 to 12.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed the player to gain 2 basic or primary spells at the start of a run.
[*]Fixed a bug where the Ghost Form spell was interrupted by free/pseudo spell casts.
[*]Fixed a bug where the Lash (Hydra) spell branches were misaligned if using a gamepad.
[*]Fixed a bug where the Meteor Form spell could be used to gain permanent damage immunity.
[*]Fixed a bug where the Conservator boss' trailblazer attack could damage the player while they were supposed to be untargetable or otherwise damage immune.
[*]Fixed a bug which was reducing performance while many enemies were alive at the same time.
[*]Fixed a visual bug where rune icons for spells in the spell slots were being draw under the spell inventory button.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta v0.3.04a Patch Notes
notes.content:

[*][b]New Rune - Grasping Vines (Sprawl):[/b] This spell instead roots all enemies but its base cooldown is increased to 16 seconds.

[*][b]Reworked Enemy - Imp ([i]previously Skeleton Archer[/i]):[/b] Follows the player, occasionally firing flaming projectiles.
[*][b]Reworked Enemy - Sentry ([i]previously Clockwork Cannon[/i]):[/b] Static enemy that occasionally fires a barrage of small missiles at the player.

[*][b]Buzzsaw (Sol):[/b] Damage increased from 300% of power to 400%.

notes.title: Oracle Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049139/f86e045a151547016160df189261d84de8ac588f.png[/img]

[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]New Playable Character - The Oracle[/b]: Starts with the new Oracle's Eye emblem (see below), chooses any defensive spell at level 3, and chooses any expert spell at level 5, but has worse stats. ([i]Unlocked by winning a run with the Alchemist[/i])
[*][b]New Emblem - Oracle's Eye:[/b] Whenever you use the reroll altar, you may use it again to undo the reroll and regain your reroll token any number of times. ([i]Unlocked by winning a run with the new Oracle character[/i]).
[*][b]New Spell (Basic) - Ignite:[/b] Create small columns of explosions in 4 directions, dealing (80% power) fire damage to enemies.
[*][b]New Spell (Basic) - Lash:[/b] Crack a whip of electricity towards target direction, dealing (65% power) lightning damage to enemies.
[*][b]New Spell (Basic) - Ravage:[/b] Channel to summon a mouth familiar that bites enemies in front of you, dealing (340% power) arcane damage per second.
[*][b]New Spell (Expert) - Buzzsaw:[/b] You gain a buzzsaw familiar. Casts recall the buzzsaw to your current position, dealing (450% power) arcane damage to enemies it passes through.
[*][b]New Elite - Yellow (Mortar):[/b] Regularly launches a barrage of small missiles at random nearby positions.
[*][b]Reworked Rune - Apparition (Terrify) ([i]previously Entourage[/i]):[/b] When spirits spawn, they fear enemies within 4 tiles for 3.5 seconds. Each enemy can only be feared once in this way.
[*][b]Reworked Rune - Dragon's Breath (Brood) ([i]previously Hyperventilate[/i]):[/b] You gain 4 egg familiars that surround you. This spell no longer has a cooldown or mana cost but consumes the egg in target direction to unleash a cone of fire that deals (300% power) fire damage. Eggs respawn after 12 seconds (affected by cooldown speed).
[*][b]Reworked Rune - Dragon's Breath (Inferno) ([i]previously Wildfire[/i]):[/b] Instead unleashes a circle of fire around you, damaging and knocking back enemies within 5 tiles.
[*][b]Reworked Rune - Drain Soul (Empower) ([i]previously Masochism[/i]):[/b] Each enemy drained grants you 1 bonus power 30 seconds. This bonus is reset whenever you cast this spell.
[*][b]Reworked Rune - Drain Soul (Seize) ([i]previously Horrify[/i]):[/b] Affected enemies are instead pulled towards you and stunned for 4 seconds.
[*][b]Reworked Rune - Fireball (Wildfire) ([i]previously Amplify[/i]):[/b] This spell now deals (50% power) fire damage but you gain a stack whenever you cast any other spell (up to 8 stacks). Casting this spell consumes all stacks to trigger an additional cast per stack.
[*][b]Reworked Rune - Lava Chakram (Trinity) ([i]previously Buzzsaw[/i]):[/b] This spell now has a 7 second cooldown but summons 3 chakrams, each dealing arcane damage, lightning damage, and fire damage.
[*][b]Reworked Rune - Storm Spear (Quiver) ([i]previously Ricochet[/i]):[/b] This spell no longer costs mana but you only have 5 spears to throw. Spears embed themselves in walls and are automatically collected when you are nearby or after 8 seconds.
[*][b]Reworked Emblem - Tranquility ([i]previously Meditate[/i]):[/b] After not casting any spells for 2 seconds, you gain 6 bonus life regeneration for 5 seconds.
[*][b]Reworked Emblem - Withdraw:[/b] Whenever you cast a defensive spell, all damage you take is reduced by 50% for 4 seconds.
[*][b]Reworked Elite - Purple (Infested) ([i]previously Gembound[/i]):[/b] Spawns melee spider enemies upon death.
[/list]

[h3]Player[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]The Alchemist:[/b] Base power reduced from 90 to 80, base life reduced from 120 to 100, now unlocked by winning a run with the Neophyte.
[*][b]The Neophyte:[/b] Base power reduced from 100 to 90, base life reduced from 150 to 120.
[*]Player is now invulnerable after a run to prevent death during victory cutscene.
[*]Base critical hit damage increased from 130% to 150%.
[/list]

[h3]Spells[/h3]
[list]
[*]Any unlocked basic spell and any unlocked primary spell can be chosen at the start of every run.
[*]Added a random altar to the initial spell selection phase, allowing the player to choose a random basic and/or primary starting spell.
[*]Locked spells now show unlock requirements when moused over and have a greyed-out spell icon instead of a generic lock icon in the spell encyclopedia.
[*][b]Apparition:[/b] Spirit attack cooldown increased from 0.33 seconds to 0.5.
[*][b]Black Hole:[/b] Radius reduced from 6 tiles to 5, cooldown reduced from 9 seconds to 8 but cooldown timer only starts after the black hole expires.
[*][b]Chain Lightning:[/b] Damage increased from 140% of power to 150%.
[*][b]Dragon's Breath:[/b] Cooldown increased from 7 seconds to 9.
[*][b]Drain Soul:[/b] No longer slows enemies, now knocks enemies back, life bonus per stack reduced from 3% to 2%, cooldown increased from 10 seconds to 12.
[*][b]Fireball:[/b] Damage increased from 85% of power to 100%, damage radius increased slightly.
[*][b]Grasping Vines:[/b] Cooldown reduced from 10 seconds to 5 but cooldown timer only starts after the vines expire.
[*][b]Power Fist:[/b] Damage increased from 50% of power to 70% and 140% to 180% for third casts.
[*][b]Solar Beam:[/b] Maximum damage increased from 390% of power to 450%.
[/list]

[h3]Runes[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Fireball (Splitter):[/b] Damage increased from 35% of power to 45%, spread reduced from 40 degrees to 30.
[*][b]Meteor Form (Slam):[/b] Now deals bonus damage equal to 200% of maximum life.
[*][b]Power Fist (Slugger):[/b] Spell damage no longer reduced.
[*][b]Solar Beam (Overheat):[/b] Now only prevents casting this spell instead of all fire spells, heat gained reduced from 40 per second to 30, heat decay reduced from 46 per second to 10.
[*][b]Solar Beam (Prism):[/b] Rune renamed to Refraction.
[*][b]Static Discharge (Zap):[/b] Stun duration reduced from 2.5 seconds to 2.
[/list]

[h3]Emblems[/h3]
[list]
[*]Locked emblems now show unlock requirements when moused over and have a greyed-out emblem icon instead of a generic lock icon in the emblem encyclopedia.
[*]All Invocation emblems now also grant 1 stack per second while channeling (affected by attack speed).
[*][b]Agony's Insight:[/b] Cooldown timer reduction reduced from 1 second to 0.5.
[*][b]Alchemy:[/b] Now unlocked by winning a run with the Alchemist.
[*][b]Berserker:[/b] No longer grants healing from spell damage dealt, kill threshold reduced from 100 to 80.
[*][b]Blessing of Brutality:[/b] Bonus critical hit damage increased from 40% to 50%.
[*][b]Death Defiance:[/b] Revive effect no longer refreshes upon entering a new arena.
[*][b]Dragon Heart:[/b] Damage increased from 40 to 50.
[*][b]Dynamo:[/b] Damage bonus increased from 25% to 30%.
[*][b]Frenzy:[/b] Now also grants 1 stack per second while channeling (affected by attack speed).
[*][b]Hunter's Dash:[/b] Bonus damage increased from 15% to 20%.
[*][b]Kill Time:[/b] Cooldown timer reduction reduced from 1 second to 0.5.
[*][b]Simplicity:[/b] Damage bonus increased from 10% per rank to 15%.
[*][b]Withdraw:[/b] Damage reduction increased from 50% to 75%, duration increased from 4 seconds to 4.5.
[/list]

[*]Fixed bug where the Adrenaline and Grit emblems could unintentionally provide extra bonuses.

notes.title: Alchemist Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049139/2cd0ab2edc1c274bdcbd05a843c1f76011c234dd.png[/img]

[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]New Playable Character - The Alchemist:[/b] Once unlocked, head to the bottom of the hub room and interact with the player statues to change character between runs.
[*][b]Challenge system has been trimmed while maintaining the same level of difficulty[/b]. The new order is: (i) elite enemies, (ii) stronger enemies, (iii) invasions, and (iv) arenas evolve. The effect of the previous "bigger waves" challenge level is now included in all runs by default. The effects of the previous "tougher enemies" and "stronger enemies" challenge levels have been combined into a single challenge level. ([i]I want the vast majority of challenge levels to be novel gameplay changes to avoid artificially inflating the longevity of the game, especially since challenge levels are unlocked separately for each playable character.[/i])
[*][b]New Emblem - Arcane Insight:[/b] You have 15% bonus maximum life and 2 bonus life regeneration as long as you have an arcane spell equipped.
[*][b]New Emblem - Alchemy:[/b] Healing potions drop 3.5 times more often but you no longer regenerate life.
[*][b]New Emblem - Concentration:[/b] Your spells deal 20% more damage but you can no longer move while casting.
[*][b]New Emblem - Elemental Harmony:[/b] You have 15% bonus power as long as there are 2 different elements among your equipped spells, or 30% bonus power for 3 different elements.
[*][b]New Emblem - Excessive Force:[/b] You have 30% bonus critical hit damage and critical damage from spells knocks enemies back.
[*][b]New Emblem - Fire Insight:[/b] You have 10% bonus power as long as you have a fire spell equipped.
[*][b]New Emblem - Kill Time:[/b] The next time you deal critical spell damage, all cooldown timers are reduced by 1 second. This effect refreshes after 1 second.
[*][b]New Emblem - Lightning Insight:[/b] You have 50 bonus maximum mana and 30% bonus cooldown speed as long as you have a lightning spell equipped.
[*][b]New Emblem - Marksman's Brew:[/b] Collecting healing potions causes the next spell you cast to deal critical damage. Each enemy can only be critically damaged in this way once per spell cast.
[*][b]New Emblem - Photosynthesis:[/b] All regeneration is increased by 100% but you only regenerate while not moving.
[*][b]New Emblem - Potion Guzzler:[/b] Healing potions can overheal, granting bonus maximum life that degrades over 15 seconds (stacks independently).
[*][b]New Emblem - Vigor:[/b] You have (3x life regen.)% bonus move and attack speeds.
[*][b]Reworked Emblem - Ambush:[/b] You have 30% bonus critical strike chance while your life is at 90% or higher.
[*][b]Reworked Emblem - Boulder Stance:[/b] You gain 20% bonus power, 30 bonus resistances, and knockback immunity, but your base move speed is reduced by 50%.
[*][b]Reworked Emblem - Brawler:[/b] Spell damage you deal to enemies within 4 tiles is increased by (30% resistances)%.
[*][b]Reworked Emblem - Cursed Touch:[/b] Enemies that damage you are slowed by 50% and take (10% enemy max. life) arcane damage per second for 5 seconds. Deals (3% enemy max. life) damage per second to bosses.
[*][b]Reworked Emblem - Dark Thirst:[/b] You no longer regenerate mana but you restore 5% of your maximum mana whenever an enemy dies.
[*][b]Reworked Emblem - Dragon Heart:[/b] Every 20 life you gain deals 40 fire damage to enemies within 6 tiles.
[*][b]Reworked Emblem - Elemental Devotion:[/b] Whenever you cast an elemental damage spell you gain a stack. Upon reaching 6 stacks you lose all stacks and the element of the last spell cast becomes empowered, increasing all damage you deal of that element by 15%. Only 1 element can be empowered at a time.
[*][b]Reworked Emblem - Grit:[/b] You have 0.8 bonus life regeneration and 4 bonus resistances for every 10% missing life.
[*][b]Reworked Emblem - High Voltage:[/b] Critical lightning damage stuns enemies for 1.5 seconds.
[*][b]Reworked Emblem - Maim:[/b] The first time you deal critical damage to an enemy, that damage is increased by 25% and that enemy is permanently slowed by 20%.
[*][b]Reworked Emblem - Reaper:[/b] Each enemy you kill during combat grants you 0.3 bonus maximum life until end of combat. Your maximum life is reduced by 40.
[*][b]Reworked Emblem - Reckless Strike:[/b] Basic spells deal 20% more damage but casting basic spells deals 5 true damage to you.
[*][b]Reworked Emblem - Tempest ([i]previously Trailblazer[/i]):[/b] You leave a trail of electricity as you move, dealing (70% power) lightning damage per second to enemies for 4 seconds.
[*][b]Reworked Emblem - Withdraw ([i]previously Thick Hide[/i]):[/b] After being damaged by an enemy, all damage you take is reduced by 50% for 4 seconds. This effect refreshes after 10 seconds.
[/list]

[h3]Player[/h3]
[list]
[*]Multiple instances of damage taken from enemies in a small duration is greatly reduced to help prevent the player from being bursted down before they can react.
[*]Entering a new arena now removes poison and fully heals the player.
[*]Changed how life and mana regeneration works to be more accurate (now internally measured in amount per second instead of amount per frame).
[/list]

[h3]Spells[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Chain Lightning:[/b] Cast speed reduced.
[*][b]Electric Field:[/b] Damage per second reduced from 110% of power to 65%.
[*][b]Grasping Vines:[/b] Now also spawns vines behind you, range reduce from 18 tiles to 13, duration reduced from 6 seconds to 5.5.
[*][b]Static Discharge:[/b] Damage reduced from 100-780% of power to 100-700%, base charge time reduced from 2 seconds to 1.5, damage radius increased from 5.5 tiles to 6.
[*][b]Stone Skin:[/b] Shield reduced from 40% maximum life to 30%, cooldown increased from 10 seconds to 12.
[*][b]Whirling Death:[/b] Updated visual effects.
[/list]

[h3]Runes[/h3]

[*]Skipping a rune no longer grants a random tome.

[*][b]Burst (Demolition):[/b] Number of bubbles reduced from 10 to 8, cooldown increased from 4 seconds to 5.
[*][b]Dragon's Breath (Wildfire):[/b] Damage increased from 700% of power to 720%, channel duration reduced from 0.83-1.83 seconds to 0.5-1.5, changed fully charged sound effect to be more noticeable.

[/list]

[h3]Emblems[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Arcane Invocation:[/b] Bonus resistances reduced from 9 to 4 per stack, no longer grants bonus cooldown speed for 7 seconds (stacks up to 5 times).
[*][b]Adrenaline:[/b] Now grants 4 bonus power and 4% bonus attack speed per stack, no longer grants bonus move speed or bonus resistances.
[*][b]Affinity Emblems:[/b] Damage bonus reduced from 15/30% to 10/20%.

[*][b]Agony’s Insight:[/b] Cooldown timer reduction reduced from 1.5 seconds to 1.
[*][b]Avatar:[/b] Cycle interval reduced from 6 seconds to 5, bonus damage increased from 25% to 40%, now reduces the damage of other elements by 30%.
[*][b]Berserker:[/b] Bonus attack speed reduced from 80% to 50%.
[*][b]Blessing of Brutality:[/b] Bonus critical hit damage increased from 20% to 40%.
[*][b]Blessing of Elusivity:[/b] Bonus ranged resistance reduced from 20 to 12.
[*][b]Blessing of Rejuvenation:[/b] Bonus life regeneration reduced from 3 to 2.
[*][b]Blessing of Strength:[/b] Bonus power reduced from 14 to 10.
[*][b]Blessing of Toughness:[/b] Bonus melee resistance reduced from 20 to 12.
[*][b]Close Combat:[/b] Damage bonus reduced from 14/28% to 15/25%.
[*][b]Crippling Aura:[/b] Movement speed slow increased from 20% to 60%, attack speed slow reduced from 20% to 15%.
[*][b]Elemental Assault:[/b] Now causes enemies to take 15% more damage while marked by 2 elements or 25% more damage while marked by 3 elements instead of increasing damage taken by 7% per element, changed emblem icon.
[*][b]Enlightened:[/b] Bonus power increased from flat 15 to 15%, grants 20 bonus resistances instead of granting evasion, changed emblem icon.
[*][b]Entropy:[/b] Damage per second increased from 600% of life regeneration to 10x, damage ticks per second increased from 1 to 2, no longer plays non-critical hit damage sounds, radius effect improved.
[*][b]Essence Shift:[/b] Heal reduced from 18% of mana spent to 10%.
[*][b]Fairy Ring:[/b] Bonus life regeneration reduced from 6 to 4.
[*][b]Fire Invocation:[/b] Bonus critical strike chance increased from 2.5% per stack to 3%, bonus critical strike damage increased from 5% per stack to 6%.
[*][b]Frenzy:[/b] Bonus attack speed reduced from 2/4% per stack to 1/3%.
[*][b]Hail of Blades:[/b] Projectiles now pierce to damage enemies in a line, damage reduced from 80% of power to 50%, improved visual effects, changed emblem icon.
[*][b]Heavy Hitter:[/b] Damage bonus reduced from 25% to 20%.
[*][b]Hunter’s Dash:[/b] Damage bonus reduced from 18% to 15%.
[*][b]Invigorating Brew:[/b] Changed emblem icon.

[*][b]Lightning Invocation:[/b] Now grants 0.33 bonus move speed per stack, no longer grants bonus maximum mana.
[*][b]Malaise:[/b] Enemy power reduction increased from 18% to 25%, now also increases enemy damage taken by 5%.

[*][b]Mine Layer:[/b] Now deals fire damage, damage increased from 50% of power to 70%, maximum number of mines reduced from 16 to 10, mine duration reduced from 12 seconds to 8, refresh time reduced from 8 seconds to 3.

[*][b]Time Leak:[/b] Clock catch radius increased from 1.8 tiles to 2, catch altitude threshold increased.

notes.title: Spell Rune Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049139/6c73b6b6feeef5bf15d12e4a8824b1a12b292039.png[/img]

[h3]Hi everyone! FIrst of all, I'd like to apologize for the delay in getting this update out and thank you for your patience. It took longer than expected to design and implement all the spell runes but I also experienced some burnout due to feeling extremely unmotivated and stressed at my day job while feeling overwhelmed by feedback on Neophyte. This is my first commercial release and I'm still learning how to support a game, which includes community management and implementing feedback. Please note that I read pretty much all of your feedback (especially if it's on my discord server which I check regularly) but I am terrible at replying.

I have come to an agreement with my boss whereby I will be spending less time at the office so I can have dedicate more time towards game dev. I plan to have more frequent updates leading up to the v1.0 release.

- Max (a.k.a. Regal Pigeon)[/h3]

[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Spell Rune System[/b]: During runs, you now choose runes from the choice altars that change how a specific spell works (max. 1 per spell). The first rune draft occurs at level 4, and then every 2 levels thereafter.
[*][b]Challenge Level 7 - Arenas Evolve[/b]: After completing the first 2 rounds of combat in an arena, it gains a random hazard specific to that arena.
[*]Stat panel can be moused over for additional information.
[*][b]Emblem  - Hubris[/b]: As long as you have no basic spells equipped, you have 45% bonus cooldown speed and your spells deal 20% more damage.
[*][b]Emblem  - Meditate[/b]: After standing still and not casting any spells for 1 second, you gain 6 bonus life regeneration for 5 seconds.
[*][b]Emblem  - Tumbler[/b]: Evading damage by dashing restores 15% of your life and 20% of your mana and refreshes your dash cooldown. This effect refreshes after 2 seconds.
[*][b]Enemy  - Screecher[/b]: Flies around the player launching piercing sound waves.
[/list]

[h3]Emblems[/h3]
[list]
[*]Reduced the maximum rank for all “Affinity” emblems from 3 to 2.
[*]Reduced the maximum rank for all “Blessing” emblems from 2 to 1.
[*]Renamed the 3 “Elemental” emblems to “Invocation”, improved their emblem icons.
[*][b]Agony’s Insight[/b]: Damage threshold reduced from 30 to 20, cooldown reduction reduced from 2.5 seconds to 1.5.
[*][b]Blessing of Haste[/b]: Speed bonus increased from 0.8 tiles per second to 1.5.
[*][b]Blessing of Power[/b]: Bonus power increased from 12 to 14.
[*][b]Dark Thirst[/b]: Mana restore changed from 2% of max. mana to 1%.
[*][b]Emergency Supply[/b]: Minor healing potions created by this emblem now only last for 6 seconds.
[*][b]Patience[/b]: Instead grants bonuses based on the number of cooldown spells equipped: +15 resistances for 1 spell, +30% move speed for 2 spells, +50% cooldown speed for 3 spells, and +40 power for 4 spells.
[*][b]Sharpshooter[/b]: Maximum damage bonus increased from 20% to 25%, maximum bonus range threshold reduced from 12 tiles to 10.
[*][b]Time Leak[/b]: Cooldown timer reduction reduced from 5 seconds to 2.5.
[/list]

[h3]Enemies[/h3]
[list]
[*]Base maximum life bonus per level for all enemies increased from 6 to 8.
[*]Reduced the move speeds and increased the attack cooldowns for most enemies.
[*]Catacombs arena enemy types all appear earlier (e.g. skeleton archers now appear on level 1).
[*]Clock Room enemies can spawn closer to the player.
[*]Changed how enemy pathfinding works which should increase performance.
[*][b]Elites[/b]: Maximum life bonus reduced from 40% to 20%, flat maximum life bonus increased from 200 to 350, power bonus reduced from 60% to 50%.
[*][b]Rework - Clockwork Golem ([i]previously Beholder[/i])[/b]: Same laser attack but on a clock-tick based cooldown, now has jumping movement and longer moves while attacking.
[*][b]Rework - Giant Frog ([i]previously Mutant[/i])[/b]: Now has jumping movement and spits a cone of poison that lingers for brief duration.
[*][b]Rework - Vulture ([i]previously Construct[/i])[/b]: Now extends a damaging pitchfork towards the direction of movement instead of dealing contact damage, making it safer for the player to attack with melee spells.
[*][b]Clockwork Cannon[/b]: Appears less often and later in the Clock Room, base life increased, base power increased, missile damage radius increased, attack cooldown reduced.
[*][b]Clockwork Soldier[/b]: Can now attack the player at any time they are in range instead of on clock-tick only, attack lunge range reduced.
[*][b]Skeleton Archer[/b]: Player follow range reduced.
[*][b]Spinner[/b]: Maximum move speed while spinning increased.
[/list]

[h3]Player[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Melee/ranged resistances[/b]: Now grants [i](100 / (100 + Resistance))[/i]% damage reduction instead of a flat % damage reduction, similar to other games such as League of Legends. This allows resistances to be uncapped with diminishing returns.
[/list]

[h3]Spells[/h3]
[list]
[*]Adjusted mana costs and cooldowns of most spells.
[*]Base player power increased from 70 to 100 and all basic/primary spell damage power factors have been lowered accordingly to keep their starting damage roughly the same. [[i]This effectively buffs all expert damage spells while reducing the power scaling of basic/primary spells.[/i]]
[*]Updated all spell descriptions.
[*][b]Rework - Dragon’s Breath ([i]previously Acid Fire[/i])[/b]: No longer ignites enemies but applies a heavy knockback.
[*][b]Rework - Force Wall ([i]previously Earth Wall[/i])[/b]: Now summons pillars of energy that repel enemies more consistently. The player can now freely move in between the pillars without colliding.
[*][b]Rework - Starfall ([i]previously Shooting Star[/i])[/b]: You gain a marker that orbits you at fixed distance. Casting summons a star that crashes down on the marker's position after a brief delay, dealing arcane damage to enemies in an area.
[*][b]Rework - Storm Spear ([i]previously Storm Bow[/i])[/b]: Visual rework, the mechanics of the spell remain unchanged except range is now infinite.
[*][b]Apparition[/b]: Damage increased from 75% of power to 90%.
[*][b]Black Hole[/b]: No longer deals damage, mana cost reduced from 50 to 30,  improved radius effect.
[*][b]Drain Soul[/b]: Now grants you 3% bonus maximum life per enemy for 7 seconds instead of healing, radius reduced from 4 tiles to 3.5.
[*][b]Electric Field[/b]: Damage increased from 60% of power per second to 110%, radius increased from 5 tiles to 7, mana cost reduced from 40 to 30, duration reduced from 6 seconds to 5.
[*][b]Grasping Vines[/b]: Range increased from 14 tiles to 18, duration increased from 5 seconds to 6.
[*][b]Invigorate[/b]: Now grants a flat 30% attack speed bonus and a 60% maximum mana bonus for 6.5 seconds.
[*][b]Lava Chakram[/b]: Danage increased from 70% of power to 75%, mana cost reduced from 30 to 26.
[*][b]Power Fist[/b]: Changed colour of effects to blue to better match other lightning spells/effects.
[*][b]Solar Beam[/b]: Maximum damage increased from 520% of power per second to 550%.
[*][b]Static Discharge[/b]: Damage increased from 600% of power to 780%, damage radius reduced from 6 tiles to 5.5.
[*][b]Whirling Death[/b]: Mana cost reduced from 25 to 22.
[/list]

[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*]All arenas are larger.
[*]Poison now deals damage based on current life instead of maximum life, added a unique poision damage sound, improved status effect icon and visual effects.
[*][b]Challenge Level VI - Invasions[/b]: A banner message now appears when the invasion portal spawns.
[*][b]Tome - Cooldown Speed[/b]: Bonus increased from 12% to 20%.
[*][b]Tome - Power[/b]: Bonus power increased from 4 to 5.
[*]Spell runes can now be viewed in the hub room spell encyclopedia. Use left click and right click on a spell page to switch runes.
[*]Knockback effects all characters more.
[*]Reroll altar sprite updated.
[*]Object spawn effect updated.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Changed how the save system works which should prevent a rare bug that caused the save file to be erased.
[*]Changed how dashing works which should fix a bug where the player became immune to all damage (even after restarting the run).
[*]Fixed a bug that would allow certain cooldown spells to be recast while already active if the cooldown timer was reduced to zero via cooldown reducing emblems such as Time Leak and Agony’s Insight.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.0.20 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi everyone! This patch was somewhat delayed, mainly due to the addition and removal of a Victory Laps/Endless Mode feature. What was meant to be a little optional feature turned out to be quite contentious within the beta testing community and I also wasn't happy with either implementation. It felt like an unsatisfying band-aid fix to stretch out the game until more content could be added. Rather than continuing to try to make it work, I think it's best if the idea is shelved so I can focus on adding more content. I may revisit Endless Mode/Victory Laps in the future.
